}}'''Fera Sormen''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]], who is secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|10|24}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fera Sormen|Fera}}

== Strength ==
Fera is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]] with a strength level of {{opsl|39}}.

== History ==
She was born in {{ne|864}}, and went to the White Tower in {{ne|882}}. She spent 13 years as a novice and 9 as Accepted.

==Activities==
She was on the [[White Tower]] secret expedition to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

She was taken prisoner by the [[Asha'man]] at [[Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}} and has sworn fealty to [[Rand al'Thor]]{{ref/book|9|13}}. However, unlike the other Aes Sedai, her oath was a lie.{{ref||Fera}}

Elza Penfell and Fera travel together from Tar Valon to Cairhien. They discover that they share a dark allegiance{{ref/book|10|24}}.

It is presumed that Fera, along with the other Black Ajah prisoners, was [[Compulsion|Compelled]] by [[Verin Mathwin]] to serve Rand and ensure that he doesn't die until the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]]{{ref/book|8|p}}. However, the Wheel of Time Companion reveals that Fera's oath to serve Rand was a lie, allowed by her Black Ajah affiliation and foreswearing of the Three Oaths. This would mean that Verin's compulsion failed; indeed, requirements for Verin's compulsion to work were that the subject trusted Verin and could find a reason within herself to follow Verin's orders. It would have been easy for Fera to overcome either of these conditions.
